needed.evidence: A continuous wall runs along the left edge of the carriageway with no usable footway, forcing pedestrians into the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a 1.5 m wide concrete footway between the wall and the carriageway edge.

needed.evidence: A long boundary wall on the right leaves no space for a footway, so pedestrians must use the road.
needed.suggestion: Provide a 1.5 m wide footway along the right wall, narrowing the carriageway if necessary.

needed.evidence: Buildings and potential destinations line both sides, creating crossing demand, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility markings at the mid-point of the segment.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along this urban street, leaving it unlit at night.
needed.suggestion: Install a row of LED street lights on both sides of the road to illuminate the carriageway and any new footways.
